params.body:
## Why

Ilse (2026-09-16): on two dealer sites the embedded stock list is cut off after the first page and "next page" is unreachable. The dealer's site sets `scrolling="no"` on the iframe and grows it with the `documentHeight` message our page posts (the listener script the dealer team hands to web builders). Since the rebuild the list loads more cards while scrolling, but the page only posted its height on load, so the parent kept the first-page height, everything below was clipped and the load-more sentinel never came into view.

While reproducing, a second cause surfaced: the load-more script lived in the filter partial (`search.blade.php`). A dealer with the filter form switched off (`website_filter_integration` unset) never got that partial, saw "laden…" at the bottom and nothing ever loaded, in or out of an iframe.

## Fix

- `website/index.blade.php` and `website/detail.blade.php`: post `documentHeight` on every change of the `.website_wrapper` height (ResizeObserver, `setInterval` fallback), only when the value differs from the last one posted.
- `website/index.blade.php`: the infinite scroll now lives on the index page as `window.websiteInfinite`, reads the search URL from `data-more` on `#vehicles` (`website/vehicles.blade.php`) and includes the filter form in the request when it exists. `search.blade.php` calls `websiteInfinite.init()` after a filter change, as before.
- Rule R S2-5.17 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/12-s2-eigen-wagenpark-publiceren.md`; finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-16-iframe-hoogte-volgt-niet.md`.

## Test

`tests/Feature/WebsiteIframeHeightTest.php`: the list page carries the `documentHeight` message and the ResizeObserver; a dealer without the filter form still gets `websiteInfinite.init()` and `data-more`. Also green: `WebsiteWarrantyCalculatorTest`, `SettingsWebsiteIframeLanguageTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, the `website.*` smoke entries.

Verified locally in a parent page with the listener script dealers received and `scrolling="no"`, 39 vehicles: the iframe grew 2510 to 4015 px and all 39 cards rendered, with the filter form on and off.

## Compatibility

The listener script dealers already have keeps working unchanged: the message name (`documentHeight`, `messageName`/`messageValue`) and the origin `https://traders.stocklistdealer.eu` are the same. Note for the dealer team, not for this PR: that script calls `iFrame.scrollIntoView()` on every message, which will now jump the page to the iframe on every load-more, and it has a stray `;` after the `if (... > 500)`; both are better removed in the snippet they hand out.
params.title: Website embed: the iframe reports its height on every change, so parent sites stop clipping the list
